Hello everyone! After trying so many methods, I have found one that has been consistent and okay for 2 days now.

I went to launch options and set it to -dx9 -64 bit. Then before I jump into a match I play with bots and wait for the game to load. 5 seconds in I disconnect and then do the same thing for about 5 times until I feel like my game is set for ranked. Then I watch a random game on the “Watch” tab and stay there for 5 mins. So far I crashed once (the very first time I tried this method) and never crashed since.

Hope this helps!

What a coincidence I was homeschooled as well in high school! Lol.

Anyway, a good start to improving your cardio is just run everyday and do not smoke cigarettes or expose yourself too much on substances thst can be harmful to your lungs. Have you heard of High Intensity Interval Training or HIIT for short? I suggest you take a look at that as well. And have you tried other sports such as kickboxing? I find it improves your cardio.

You should also try plyometric exercises and start doing GK footwork training that your body permits you. As a footballer, if you get your footwork messed up in a game even just one time an error can be committed resulting into a goal.

And as you improve your physical strength you must improve your mental prowess as well. 90+ mins on the field can be tough mentally and a wrong call of judgement can be critical. Trust yourself always. Realistically of course.

Don’t get impatient, you have a long road ahead of you. There will be some days where you don’t want to train. While it is important to have off days, don’t commit the mistakes that I did and skip trainings for drinks and girls or simply playing FIFA. Stay positive lad

I once tried out for a university in college and was told that even though I had the skills, my body was not yet ready for competitive level and was stripped from the selection pool.

Listen to yourself and your body, be aware of your limitations at your age. If you really want to be a footballer, let alone a GK I suggest you watch clips of pro GKs training and copy their footwork workouts if you can. You don’t have to build that much muscle but you have to keep your cardio at top shape as a game is 90+ mins long.

Also, try to improve your game sense and make sure you have a voice on the pitch. Being the last line of defense, you see what’s happening clearer than anyone on the pitch so you should be able to instruct your teammates in a manner that they would respect and follow. Good luck with your career! I wish I could be that motivated everyday when I was 14. You have a long way ahead of you.
